plain_description.what: Checks whether a proposed 'foreign arrival' alarm, which compares a leaf's purity on new data with its training purity, fires on Law questions absorbed into another region and not on genuine Philosophy regions. It uses existing artefacts and no calls.
plain_description.why: It tests whether the tree can detect when new kinds of queries arrive in a cell, as the framework design requires.
plain_description.information: Firing on Law but not Philosophy would show the alarm works. Result: undetermined, because the alarm's written definition is ambiguous in two places that flip the outcome. Under one reasonable reading (the reference is the anchor name, with the leaf's own training purity minus 2 SD), the Law regions do trip. The design must fix both definitions before the item can be scored.
